signedOut.title: Sign in to open the admin panel
signedOut.lead: Managing products, orders and customers is waiting for you once you sign in.

welcome.intro: This is the admin panel of the “Zielony Koszyk” shop. Pick a section below to manage products, orders and customers.

sections.products: Add products, change prices and stock levels, and swap out photos.
sections.orders: Browse orders, their statuses and customer details, and issue invoices.
sections.users: Manage customer accounts, delivery addresses and roles in the shop.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Catalogue, prices and stock levels. Edit price, stock and category in the table, and the name and description in the edit window.

create.title: Add product
create.subtitle: The product appears in the catalogue as soon as it is saved. The name and description are required in both languages.

edit.title: Edit product
edit.subtitle: Change the name and description in both languages, along with the shared product details.
